question: Can a ciphertext-only front end and a frozen monoalphabetic solver recover new known messages encoded with dedicated null and verbose markers, then transfer the same rule and key without refitting?
timing: Local prospective freeze of sources, normalization, protocol and experiment code before generation, toy checks, any new fitting or scoring. Source headers and availability may be inspected beforehand. Not an external preregistration and not operator-blind.
sources: New-to-this-project authors: Apuleius Metamorphoses in Latin and Manzoni I promessi sposi in Italian. Latin edition text only, excluding TEI notes/heads; Italian starts at Quel ramo del lago di Como, ends before FINE, drops chapter headings, illustration captions and numbered note paragraphs. NFKD, drop combining accents, lowercase, extract a-z words; apostrophes/punctuation become word boundaries. Preserve u/v and i/j. Original bytes/connector text and exact normalized files are frozen. Reference models remain archived Caesar and Dante Inferno/Purgatorio; do not train on the new author plaintexts.
partitions: For each new source, three pairs: fit 1000 whole words starting at indices 0,4000,8000; skip 100 words; transfer next 400 words. Half-open ranges. No overlap between any fit/test ranges within a source. Six underlying passage pairs, four paired encoding variants each, not 24 independent passages. Two new authors, not representative samples of all Latin or Italian.
known_information: The correct reference language and exact normalized word spaces are supplied. Cipher alphabet, unit rule and substitution key are unknown to the fitting process. Ciphertext is noiseless. This does not solve the failed space-recovery problem of phases20-22.

positive_families.mono: One random bijection from 26 plaintext letters to 26 of 28 opaque symbols; no markers.
positive_families.terminal: Append a dedicated symbol to every word, absent from every base letter.
positive_families.verbose: A fixed random subset of 12 letters is encoded by its base symbol followed by one shared dedicated marker; the other 14 letters have one symbol. Marker never occurs as a base letter.
positive_families.combined: Apply verbose expansion then append the distinct dedicated terminal marker. Same opaque substitution across each paired set. All maps reversible. This is much narrower than arbitrary digraph substitution or homophony.

inference: Use fit ciphertext only. At least100 words. Enumerate no terminal or one symbol appearing exactly once at the end of EVERY word, leaving each word nonempty. After optional terminal removal, enumerate no verbose marker or a candidate with >=100 occurrences whose every occurrence is immediately after a base; >=4 distinct such bases each occur >=5 times and ALWAYS immediately precede that marker. Check the entire pairing grammar. Keep candidates with <=26 surviving symbol types. Select the unique candidate with the largest number of marker mechanisms (0..2); ties abstain. Retain ALL candidate grammars in output. This maximal-removal assumption is intentionally explicit and can erase real letters; the adversary measures that limitation. It is not identifiable from ciphertext alone.
solver: Byte-exact Phase18 C++ solver, anchor26; fixed-space monoalphabetic substitution, all26 slots retained. Latin/Italian reference character4grams with alpha0.01; frequency smoothing0.5. Objective log2 quadgram likelihood minus4 times letter-frequency divergence. Eight restarts,60000 annealing steps each,temp0.002; final existing greedy passes. Seed281000+opaque case index. No restarts added, key repair, model comparison, language selection or budget change after outcomes.
transfer: Fit all36 cases, archive results, then decode transfer with each frozen fitted grammar and key. Never refit on transfer. A symbol absent from fitted alphabet is '?', even if a true key could resolve it. Grammar violations are explicit errors. Evaluation opens known truth only after every transfer prediction is written. Code/process separation is auditable; the operator can access the truth and no cryptographic or human blinding is claimed.

challenges.distinct_digraphs: Six paired known-message cases: every letter gets its base symbol plus a different dedicated second symbol (26 additional symbols). Reversible but outside the shared-marker family. May abstain; no compulsory success and no retuning.
challenges.no_target_passage: Four character first-order Markov texts from old reference words only, two per language; empirical initial letters, transition counts and word-length sampling.1000 fit/400 transfer generated words, then combined encoding. No selected literary passage; inherits spelling statistics and can generate real words. Algebraic recovery does not establish intended meaning. No threshold is selected to separate these from literature.
challenges.genuine_final_adversary: Two samples from reference vocabulary words containing exactly one a, at the end, length>1; random draws1000/400, plain monoalphabetic encoding. Final a is genuine, not inserted. The same visible distribution admits terminal-null analysis. Report false removal; not a positive calibration case. This tests nonidentifiability and prohibits an automatic semantic or general unit-decoding claim even if the24 positives all pass.

gates: Toy mechanical checks must pass before generating cases. Primary positive calibration gate requires ALL24 cases to recover exact true units in fit AND transfer, correct actual marker roles, and exact transfer plaintext (including known spaces). Missing/incorrect letters fail strict exact recovery. Report edit accuracy, fit exactness, unseen transfer symbols and per-case failures secondarily; no weaker replacement gate. Baseline mono cases must retain every genuine character. Outside-family and no-target cases remain diagnostic, never used for tuning.
manuscript: Calibration-only phase. No Voynich fit, unit removal or translation in this phase, regardless of calibration outcome. Existing manuscript reserves are already exposed. A broader identifiable encoding model and an explicit separate protocol are needed before any manuscript application.
seeds: Cipher280000+100*language_index+base_index, shared across paired variants. Markov282000+10*language_index+replicate. Adversary283000+language_index. Toy289001. Language order Latin,Italian. Exact generation order in source is frozen; truth ledger retains categories and actual keys separately from solver input.
verification: Independent cipher inversion, source-range provenance, fit/test nonoverlap, unit and character metrics, direct objective rescoring, freeze and prior manifests. Full generation/fit/transfer/evaluation replay in isolated copy. Software checks are not external human linguistic confirmation.
preservation: Baseline78e319833138055d288f4bc8c65fa79b23ec828b. Earlier phases unchanged. Local commits and standalone review bundle; no push, external messaging or publication.
